exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: A compound lower-body lift where a loaded barbell rests across the upper back while the lifter squats down and drives back up.
exercises.note: Keep your chest up and drive through mid-foot on the way up.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.description: A full-body pulling movement where a barbell is lifted from the floor to hip level by extending the hips and knees together.
exercises.note: Push the floor away with your legs before your back takes over.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A horizontal pressing exercise performed lying on a flat bench, lowering a barbell to the chest and pressing it back up.
exercises.note: Retract your shoulder blades and keep your feet planted for a stable base.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: A vertical pulling bodyweight exercise where the lifter hangs from a bar and pulls their chin above it.
exercises.note: Initiate the pull by driving your elbows down toward your hips.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: A standing barbell press that moves the bar from shoulder height to full lockout overhead.
exercises.note: Brace your core hard to avoid overarching your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise that flexes the elbow to curl a pair of dumbbells from the thighs up to shoulder height.
exercises.note: Avoid swinging the weight — let the biceps do the work.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
exercises.description: An isolation exercise using a cable machine and a bar or rope attachment to extend the elbows against resistance.
exercises.note: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: A machine-based compound exercise where the lifter pushes a weighted platform away using the legs while seated at an angle.
exercises.note: Avoid locking your knees out fully at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A hip-hinge exercise performed with a barbell, lowering the weight along the legs while keeping the knees only slightly bent.
exercises.note: Feel the stretch in your hamstrings and stop before your back rounds.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core-stability exercise holding a straight-line body position supported on the forearms and toes.
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes and avoid letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A machine exercise that pulls a cable-attached bar down toward the upper chest while seated, targeting the back.
exercises.note: Lead with your elbows rather than pulling with your hands.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: A unilateral rowing exercise performed bracing one hand and knee on a bench while pulling a dumbbell to the hip with the other arm.
exercises.note: Keep your torso still and pull with your elbow, not your hand.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: A dynamic lower-body exercise stepping forward into alternating lunges while carrying dumbbells or a barbell.
exercises.note: Keep your front knee tracking over your toes with each step.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: A glute-focused exercise where the upper back rests on a bench and the hips drive a loaded barbell upward.
exercises.note: Tuck your chin and drive through your heels at the top.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: A cable exercise pulling a rope attachment toward the face at eye level to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
exercises.note: Flare your elbows high and squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise raising the heels off the ground while standing, usually loaded with a machine or dumbbells.
exercises.note: Pause briefly at the top and control the descent.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: A pressing exercise performed on an inclined bench with dumbbells to emphasize the upper chest.
exercises.note: Set the bench to a moderate 30-45 degree angle to keep the focus on the chest.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.description: An isolation exercise bringing two cable handles together in front of the chest in a wide arcing motion.
exercises.note: Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the arc.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: A horizontal pulling exercise performed seated at a low cable pulley, rowing a handle toward the torso.
exercises.note: Drive your chest forward slightly before pulling to get a full stretch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: An isolation exercise raising dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height to target the middle deltoids.
exercises.note: Lead with your elbows and avoid using momentum to swing the weight up.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: A biceps and forearm exercise curling dumbbells with a neutral, palms-facing-in grip.
exercises.note: Keep your wrists locked in the neutral position throughout.

exercises.name: Lying Tricep Extension (Skull Crusher)
exercises.description: An isolation exercise lying on a bench and lowering a barbell or EZ-bar toward the forehead by bending only the elbows.
exercises.note: Keep your upper arms stationary and pointed toward the ceiling.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: A core exercise hanging from a pull-up bar and raising the legs toward the torso using the lower abdominals.
exercises.note: Avoid swinging — control the movement on the way down too.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat variation performed with the rear foot elevated on a bench behind the lifter.
exercises.note: Keep most of your weight on the front leg and descend under control.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken & Rice Bowl
recipes.description: A simple high-protein bowl of seasoned grilled chicken over rice with steamed broccoli, finished with a drizzle of olive oil.
steps: Season the chicken fillets with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Steam the broccoli florets for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Slice the chicken and divide it with the rice and broccoli between two bowls.
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: A no-cook breakfast of rolled oats soaked overnight in milk and yogurt, topped with fresh blueberries.
steps: Combine the oats, milk, yogurt, and chia seeds in a jar or container.
Stir well until fully mixed.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with blueberries before serving.

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes blended with whey protein and oats for a post-workout-friendly breakfast, topped with fresh banana.
steps: Blend the eggs, oats, protein powder, and milk until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it.
Pour small rounds of batter into the pan and cook until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook the other side until golden.
Serve topped with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of thick Greek yogurt and blueberries topped with almonds and a drizzle of peanut butter for crunch and healthy fats.
steps: Spoon half of the yogurt into a glass or jar.
Add a layer of blueberries, then repeat with the remaining yogurt and berries.
Top with chopped almonds.
Drizzle with peanut butter and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Salmon & Broccoli Sheet Pan
recipes.description: An easy one-pan dinner of roasted salmon fillets with broccoli and carrots, seasoned and finished with olive oil.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Toss the broccoli and carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Nestle the salmon fillets among the vegetables and season them as well.
Roast for 18-20 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and vegetables are tender.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
recipes.description: A hearty, lean chili simmered with ground turkey, bell peppers, and carrots for a warming high-protein dinner.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it apart, until browned.
Stir in the bell pepper and carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then reduce heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Veggie Omelette
recipes.description: A quick savory omelette packed with spinach and bell pepper, ideal for a light high-protein meal any time of day.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and sauté the spinach and pepper for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the eggs over the vegetables and let them set around the edges.
Fold the omelette in half once mostly set and cook for another minute.
Slide onto a plate and serve.

recipes.name: Post-Workout Smoothie
recipes.description: A quick blended shake combining whey protein, banana, and peanut butter for fast post-training recovery.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

posts.content: Big news: our new squat rack section opens this Saturday with six brand-new stations. Come check it out and say hi at the front desk for a free shaker bottle while supplies last.
Happy Monday! Remember, consistency beats intensity every single time. Show up today even if it's just for twenty minutes — future you will thank you.
Quick coaching tip: if your lower back rounds during deadlifts, drop the weight and rebuild the pattern from the floor up. No ego, just good reps.
Heads up — the 6:30am spin class on Tuesdays is moving to 7:00am starting next week to make room for a new mobility class. Full updated schedule is posted at the front desk.
The locker room showers on the east side will be closed for maintenance this Thursday from 10am to 2pm. West side showers stay open as usual, sorry for the inconvenience!
Shoutout to Daniel Kim for hitting a 30lb PR on his deadlift this week! Five months of showing up consistently is really starting to pay off. Proud of you.
Ironclad Fitness will be open reduced hours on Thanksgiving Day, 7am-1pm, and closed on Christmas Day. Normal hours resume December 26th. Happy holidays, everyone!
Our 4-week Push Pull Legs challenge kicks off this Monday. Sign up at the front desk to get a free program printout and be entered to win a month of personal training.
Friendly reminder to re-rack your weights and wipe down equipment after use — small habit, huge difference for everyone training around you.
New mobility and stretching class launching this Sunday at 9am. Great for anyone dealing with tight hips or shoulders from heavy lifting during the week.
We just restocked the smoothie bar with fresh mango and spinach blends. Perfect post-workout refuel on your way out.
The shop just got a fresh shipment of whey isolate and creatine back in stock after last week's sellout. Grab yours before they're gone again!
Gift cards are 10% off for the rest of the month — a great excuse to treat a friend or family member to their first month at Ironclad.
Thank you to everyone who came out to our 5K charity run this past weekend. Together we raised over $2,400 for the local youth sports program!
This month's challenge: log three strength sessions a week for four weeks straight. Finishers get a shoutout wall spot and a free protein shaker.
Progress isn't always visible on the scale. Better sleep, more energy, and lifting heavier than last month all count. Keep going.
Summit Strength Collective is officially open in LoDo! Come tour the new strength floor and grab a free protein shake this weekend.
Altitude makes everything feel harder here in Denver — give yourself an extra rep of rest between heavy sets and trust the process.
Reminder: the 6am and 7am strength classes are now capped at 12 people so book your spot on the app ahead of time.
Loved coaching the beginner squat clinic today. Depth over ego, every single time — proud of everyone who showed up.
Coastal Barbell Club now has ocean-view cardio bays on the second floor. Best sunrise treadmill session in San Diego, guaranteed.
Programming note: deload week starts Monday for anyone running Push Pull Legs with us. Trust the lighter loads, your joints will thank you.
Heads up — parking lot resurfacing runs through Friday, please use the side entrance on Adams Avenue during that time.
New hydration vests just landed at Trailhead — perfect timing before the fall trail race season kicks off.
Mile-high training tip: hydrate more than you think you need to. Water bottle refill stations are on every floor.
Thank you to everyone who came out for our founders' week open house. Coastal Barbell Club would be nothing without this community.
